subject.title: fix(agents): emit diagnostic when sessions_yield parks without continuation evidence

question: Should any active descendant run or successful cron addition count as enough continuation evidence to suppress the bare-yield diagnostic when it is not proven fresh or correlated to this yielded turn?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but this choice defines the product contract between paused-turn state, future wake ownership, and user-visible warnings; source and tests cannot establish the intended policy.

options.title: Require Correlated Wake Evidence
options.body: Suppress the diagnostic only for continuation state proven to wake or visibly deliver to this yielded session, with tests for unrelated existing descendants and cron jobs.

options.title: Accept the Broad Heuristic
options.body: Treat any active descendant or successful cron addition as sufficient and accept that some no-fresh-source yields may remain silent.

options.title: Defer to Tool Enforcement
options.body: Pause this PR until sessions_yield validation owns a stricter continuation contract at tool execution time.

recommendation.title: Require Correlated Wake Evidence
recommendation.body: Suppress the diagnostic only for continuation state proven to wake or visibly deliver to this yielded session, with tests for unrelated existing descendants and cron jobs.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work most recently defined the cross-surface yielded-parent lifecycle contract that this decision extends.
